title.zh: 【Greenfield 向瑞士基金会监管机构投诉 Safe Ecosystem Foundation 治理问题】
title.en: 【Greenfield 向瑞士基金会监管机构投诉 Safe Ecosystem Foundation 治理问题】

current_state.zh: Greenfield Capital filed a supervisory complaint with Switzerland's ESA against Safe Ecosystem Foundation, alleging Gnosis-linked founders pressured Safe directors into giving up a large share of SAFE tokens under threat of dumping Gnosis's ~10% supply, and seeking a board and management overhaul.
